title: Octave can run a working jellyscale of any main-line build to build against
description: Serves PRODUCT.md, The API: "Octave always has something to build against once the new contract is published: a working server for every change to it." Octave paused building against the earlier contract; it needs a server it can run itself. This is the first stop: with it, Octave builds sign-in and browsing again.
acceptanceCriteria: From published instructions, an Octave developer starts a server of any main-line build on their own machine in minutes, with a small collection of films and shows and accounts to sign in with, without asking anyone and without anything private.
The collection holds the kinds of film the server handles so far, and grows as later tasks add kinds (several versions, tracks in several languages, subtitles of each kind, HDR).
Each contract change on main is served by the build that publishes it.
Octave gets an issue saying the server is ready to build against again, with what it serves so far.
notes: First stop of the plan. The test films are made for the purpose, never taken from anyone's collection.
